mapper.select: SELECT id, min_repeat_count, amount_tolerance_pct, cycle_tolerance_days FROM tbl_fixed_expense_rule WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM tbl_user WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id

SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.merchant_name_normalized, t.amount, t.tr_date, t.category_id, t.classification, t.cancel_yn, t.is_refund, t.is_excluded_from_summary FROM tbl_transaction t WHERE ORDER BY t.merchant_name_normalized, t.tr_date, t.id

SELECT id, user_id, merchant_name_normalized, avg_amount, cycle_days, detected_count, category_id, is_excluded, status, next_expected_date, confirmed_at, relapse_detected_at FROM tbl_fixed_expense_candidate WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND merchant_name_normalized = #{merchantNameNormalized}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_fixed_expense_candidate ( user_id, merchant_name_normalized, avg_amount, cycle_days, detected_count, category_id, is_excluded, status, next_expected_date, confirmed_at, relapse_detected_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{merchantNameNormalized}, #{avgAmount}, #{cycleDays}, #{detectedCount}, #{categoryId}, 0, 'ACTIVE', #{nextExpectedDate}, NULL, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
